verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stagehand acting as an MCP server, exposing its browser tools to agents like Claude Code (stagehand-docs-11, stagehand-comm-9). It also supports WebMCP, which discovers tools that web pages expose. Neither shows Stagehand or its agent connecting to external MCP servers and using their tools, so this client-side axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
